scripts.format: uv run gdformat --line-length 100 game tools && uv run ruff check --fix --select I tools && uv run ruff format tools && prettier --write 'tools/**/*.java' 'game/**/*.json' package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.lint: uv run gdlint game tools && uv run gdformat --check --line-length 100 game tools && uv run ruff check tools && uv run ruff format --check tools && prettier --check 'tools/**/*.java' 'game/**/*.json' package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' && uv run python tools/check_godot.py
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test
